+    value = os.getenv(name)
+    if value is None:
+        return default
+    return value.strip().lower() in {"1", "true", "yes", "on"}
+
+
+def _env_int(name: str, default: int) -> int:
+    value = os.getenv(name)
+    if value is None or not value.strip():
+        return default
+    try:
+        return int(value)
+    except ValueError:
+        return default
+
+
+def load_speech_client_config() -> SpeechClientConfig:
